explanation: Fires only at the GO step when the agent picks a2 right after an unrewarded trial (usually one that ended in S1, whether by a1-common or a2-rare), and is 0 at every D1 and D2 and at every a1 choice or choice after a reward. It is strongest early in the episode (about 10 at trials 1 to 6 and right after a fresh loss in S1), about 4 to 8 for the second such a2 choice in a row, and only 0 to 4 in the middle and late episode once a2 has already been chosen for several trials.
